title.zh: 将北阿古桑武端市总医院床位由100张增至125张，并将其升格为省立医院，名称为北阿古桑省立医院，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Butuan City General Hospital in Agusan Del Norte From One Hundred (100) To One Hundred Twenty-five (125) Beds, Upgrading It Into A Provincial Hospital To Be Known As the Agusan Del Norte Provincial Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Butuan City General Hospital in Agusan Del Norte From One Hundred (100) To One Hundred Twenty-five (125) Beds, Upgrading It Into A Provincial Hospital To Be Known As the Agusan Del Norte Provincial Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Đa khoa Thành phố Butuan tại Tỉnh Agusan Del Norte từ 100 lên 125 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลทั่วไปเมือง Butuan ในจังหวัด Agusan Del Norte จาก 100 เป็น 125 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Umum Kota Butuan di Provinsi Agusan Del Norte dari 100 menjadi 125 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Besar Bandar Butuan di Wilayah Agusan Del Norte daripada 100 kepada 125 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7520_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Butuan City General Hospital in Agusan del Norte is hereby increased from one hundred (100) to one hundred twenty-five (125) beds and upgrading it into a provincial hospital to be known as the Agusan del Norte Provincial Hospital.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
